attempts.summary: Built guest-network isolation on OpenWrt node1: added two new zones (trusted=lan-a on eth1/192.168.10.0/24 linking node2, guest=lan-b on eth2/192.168.20.0/24 linking node3), allowed trusted->guest forwarding, left guest->trusted unforwarded (default reject), and kept DNS (dnsmasq) reachable from guest via zone input=ACCEPT. Configured static routing on node2/node3's secondary NICs so cross-subnet traffic transits node1. Verified with real TCP tests and a raw DNS query, both before and after restarting all three nodes one at a time (boot_id changed on each, config/services recovered).
